candidates.tagline: Delivery robot 'brake-checks' Chicago cyclist — cyclist wins
candidates.story: Coco autonomous delivery robots, deployed across Chicago pavements to modernise urban last-mile logistics, had already sent residents to hospitals and smashed through bus stops before a fixie rider filmed himself hurling one into a hedge on September 11, 2026, after it blocked and 'brake-checked' him.
candidates.why_funny: Coco's entire design premise is that autonomous robots can safely share city footpaths with humans — and the public verdict arrived in the form of one man's determined hedge-toss.
candidates.alt: A Coco autonomous delivery robot lying upturned in a roadside hedge in Chicago after being thrown there by a cyclist frustrated by being brake-checked on the pavement

candidates.tagline: Apple's $2,000+ iPhone Duo has the worst camera of any iPhone
candidates.story: Apple's iPhone Duo, announced September 9, 2026, is the most expensive iPhone ever made (starting over $2,000), yet reviewers unanimously found it has the worst camera system of the three iPhones launched — no telephoto lens, no variable aperture, and a previous-generation sensor — while the $200-cheaper iPhone 18 Pro Max has all three.
candidates.why_funny: The more you pay Apple, the fewer cameras you get: their priciest phone is missing the telephoto lens that ships on every Pro model, and Apple's official workaround is to crop a 48MP photo and call it zoom.
candidates.alt: Apple iPhone Duo foldable smartphone rear camera module showing only two camera lenses, compared to the three-lens setup on the standard iPhone 18 Pro
